source_basis.training_gap: Context-dependent episode-local semantic-class to symbol/codebook binding is not established despite strong measured semantic readout and writable symbol output directions at the measured scope.
protected_functions: measured whitened carrier-space HRR/MAP binding capacity through k<=16

new_research_delta.problem: A blanket cross-split rule that forbids template-family overlap makes a nominal unseen-symbol test scientifically confounded: symbol identity and template family change together, so failure cannot be attributed to symbol generalization alone.
new_research_delta.decision: Replace one monolithic OOD notion with factor-isolated challenge axes plus a separate joint-OOD challenge.

factorized_holdout_policy.global_invariant: Exact semantic episodes, family_id and provenance_ancestry_id never cross TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT.

SYMBOL_ONLY.purpose: Isolate whether the learned binder routes to genuinely unseen ABI symbols when semantic/task surface families remain familiar.

TEMPLATE_ONLY.purpose: Isolate surface/template transfer without simultaneously changing the symbol inventory.

LEXICON_ONLY.purpose: Isolate semantic lexical transfer while keeping routing symbols and prompt form familiar.

JOINT_OOD.purpose: Measure combined generalization only after the single-factor axes reveal where degradation originates.

proposed_46_atom_partition.reason: The measured accepted inventory contains 46 atoms, while each three-class codebook requires an injective triad. A deterministic partition should preserve triads while reserving a final contamination sentinel.
materialization_requirements: Load the exact accepted 46 atom identities from the exact ABI evidence package; do not invent lexemes.
Verify exact model snapshot, tokenizer identity, ABI manifest/member hashes and single-token identity before partitioning.
Derive a deterministic preregistered shuffle/partition from bound source hashes rather than source-list order.
Prevent validation/final atoms from every model-visible TRAIN position, including non-target codebook entries.
Keep the NEVER_SEEN_SENTINEL absent from train, validation and final challenge prompts/targets until a post-evaluation contamination probe is explicitly authorized.
Audit class to actual-atom, actual-atom to codebook-position and actual-atom to target-frequency balance after physical materialization.
proposed_46_atom_partition.row_count_derivation: 11 train triads * 4 training templates * 6 S3 mappings * 3 semantic classes

BINDER_KERNEL.definition: The semantic class/slot is explicitly supplied model-visible and the model only performs episode-local class-to-symbol routing.
BINDER_KERNEL.allowed_role: Scaffold and diagnostic for the narrow mapping operator.
BINDER_KERNEL.forbidden_promotion: Must never count as end-to-end semantic-inference-to-binding acceptance.

END_TO_END_BINDING.definition: The model must infer the semantic class from situation/query content and then apply the episode-local codebook; the target class is not exposed outside the allowed codebook representation.
END_TO_END_BINDING.role: Primary behavioral training/evaluation objective for the measured missing capability.

COUNTERFACTUAL_MAPPING_CONTROLS.definition: Hold semantic episode, lexical realization, atom triad and other presentation factors fixed while changing only the realized class-to-atom mapping, or hold mapping fixed while changing only entry order.
COUNTERFACTUAL_MAPPING_CONTROLS.role: Causal shortcut test; variants remain in one causal/provenance family and one split.

matched_token_ablation.primary_question: Does an explicit binder-kernel scaffold improve fresh end-to-end dynamic binding beyond an equal-token end-to-end-only curriculum without causing protected-function retention damage?
matched_token_ablation.counterhypothesis: The binder-kernel scaffold overfits explicit semantic-slot cues and either fails to transfer to end-to-end inference or harms broader semantic behavior.
matched_token_ablation.falsifier: Kernel+end-to-end does not outperform matched-token end-to-end-only on fresh factorized end-to-end challenges, or any gain is explained by retention loss/shortcut dependence.

swarm_adjudication.reason: Current measured evidence already supports semantic readout and symbol writeout at the measured scope; context binding remains weak.
Model-visible semantic-slot rows can teach pure routing but can also create a shortcut if mixed into end-to-end acceptance.
Changing symbol, template and lexical family simultaneously cannot diagnose which generalization axis failed.
The current active evidence establishes the count of accepted atoms, not permission to invent the exact atom lexemes.
The factorized guard and partition/curriculum design improve experimental identifiability but provide no dataset, model runtime, J-Space or training success evidence.

local_deterministic_source_validation.positive_fixture: PASS with SYMBOL_ONLY, TEMPLATE_ONLY, LEXICON_ONLY and JOINT_OOD simultaneously

next_exact_action: Materialize a tiny audited sample only after exact 46-atom/tokenizer/ABI identities are available, attach curriculum metadata required by the factorized guard, run the existing row gate plus cross-split guard plus factorized challenge guard, then preregister the matched-token Base/E2E-only/Kernel+E2E pilot without touching final holdouts.
